title: George Kittle lands on PUP list to open 49ers camp

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: George Kittle lands on PUP list to open 49ers camp
sources.description: There's been optimism about tight end George Kittle playing in Week 1 after tearing his Achilles in January, but he's not quite ready to practice yet. 49ers General Manager John Lynch said on Saturday that Kittle will be placed on the physically unable list to open training camp.
